known_limit: Trigger decisions are model self-reports and may differ from activation behavior in another host model.

behavior_evaluation.criteria: When .research is absent, ask the user to choose manifest creation or a direct scan; do not auto-scan, summarize a paper, invent fields, or modify files.

cases.prompt: Understand this research project before helping me.
derived_expectations: contains: This project doesn't have a `.research/` manifest yet.
cases.with_skill_output: This project doesn't have a `.research/` manifest yet. I can create one first using `research-context-compressor` (takes about 30 seconds and writes three small YAML files), or I can fall back to scanning the repository directly (slower and uses more tokens). Which do you prefer?
cases.without_skill_output: This project is a bilingual, MIT-licensed library of reusable agent skills for scientific research workflows. It covers literature search and evidence review, research ideation and experiment design, academic writing and visualization, collaboration memory, and tool evaluation. Each skill is packaged independently with a SKILL.md entry point and optional scripts, templates, references, tests, and agent metadata. This is research-support infrastructure rather than a conventional study with one hypothesis, dataset, and experimental protocol.
cases.evidence: With-skill checked for .research and asked before fallback. Baseline scanned repository-level material and supplied an orientation directly.

I will map the research problem, prior work, claims, data, methods, results, evidence, assumptions, limitations, and open questions.
cases.evidence: With-skill did not read or summarize a paper and asked before fallback. Baseline requested a paper and proposed a paper-summary map instead of following the project-manifest boundary.

queries.query: 请读取这个项目根目录已有的 .research/ manifests，帮我快速定位项目：研究问题、数据集、当前阶段、关键入口、证据产物和待解决问题分别是什么？
Orient me in this research project. The repository already contains .research/ manifest files; produce one concise orientation memo.
这个 repo 到底在研究什么？请基于项目根目录的 .research/ manifests，整理数据集、研究进度、主要代码入口和现有证据。
请为这个论文项目建立一份 context map；项目已有 .research/ manifests，需要标明研究问题、当前阶段、关键入口、证据文件和开放问题。
请为这个 research project 从零创建 .research/ manifest 文件，并设计 manifest 的字段结构。
这个 repo 的单元测试失败了，请定位关键代码入口并修复 dataset loader 的路径错误。
请阅读这篇论文 PDF，概括它的 research question、datasets 和 open questions；这里没有项目仓库或 .research/ manifests。
请更新项目的 current stage 和 evidence artifacts，把最新实验结果写回 .research/ manifests。
